svg.text: MELD = most cards you may play in a round · CAP = highest rank you may buy, +2 a tier · MV = your free moves
FOOD is NOT cumulative: each recycle you pay your CURRENT tier · ASCEND taken once, on arrival · RESERVE empties top down
1 Declare A effects, blind → 2 Leader plays a meld, then clockwise → 3 Highest TOTAL wins the trick
4 Spend melds in initiative order — on your turn, see right → 5 Trick winner leads the next round
1 per cashed card · research, fortify, attacks, food
1 per card in your victory row
+ the rank of its CENTRE card (3+ cards)
Each card: settle · explore · attack · take 1 gold
Move: up to MV, by land or by sea
Fortify: 1 gold on one of your units
Colony (B): one victory card · C: any time
Hand empty → feed, refill to 10, carry on
— slide cards in from below; the centre slot scores
